atAGlance: Sinh tố thanh long turns dragon fruit into a pale, speckled smoothie, mild, cooling, and gentle beside stronger tropical fruits.
whatItIs: Sinh tố thanh long is dragon fruit blended with ice and sometimes milk. Expect dragon fruit smoothie that is mild, refreshing, lightly sweet, and often beautifully pink or white.
howToEnjoy: Ask for less sugar if you want the gentle fruit flavor to stay clean.
howLocalsOrder: Order sinh tố thanh long when you want a mild, cooling smoothie. Ask whether it is red or white dragon fruit if color and flavor matter.
worthKnowing: Thanh long, dragon fruit, is one of the most visible fruits in Vietnamese markets; smoothies can be mild white-flesh or brighter pink-flesh versions.
goodToKnow: Milder than mango or passion fruit.
